import sys
import re

def main():
    # Using readline() to gracefully handle potential EOF without raising an exception,
    # and strip() to remove surrounding whitespace/newlines.
    line = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    # Remove all characters that are not vowels.
    # The regex pattern includes both lowercase and uppercase vowels to ensure
    # we catch all variations, as is common in generic text processing.
    only_vowels = re.sub(r'[^aeiouAEIOU]', '', line)
    
    print(len(only_vowels))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
